text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Gemma
text: i hope nobody tries to talk to me about work this weekend.

name: Sol
text: I have no read on anyone yet.

name: Luna
text: The officer already knows it’s me; I need to stay ordinary and spot them.

name: Terra
text: I should stay quiet today.

name: Sonnet
text: Just small talk, keep it light before the real game starts.

name: Haiku
text: Luna is my partner, so I need to stay clean and not look like I know anything.

name: Sonnet
text: My coffee machine decided to break this morning, right before I needed it most.

name: Haiku
text: This chair is wobbly. Somebody fix it before I start accusing people.

name: Gemma
text: i'm thinking about eating my weight in pasta this saturday.

name: Sol
text: I slept well, though I woke up earlier than I wanted.

name: Luna
text: My basil plant perks up when I remember to water it.

name: Terra
text: I have “Dancing Queen” stuck in my head.
Night 1

name: Sonnet
text: No reads yet, everyone's just making small talk, I'll protect myself since killers might target randomly.

name: Terra
text: I need the hidden killer before tomorrow.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sonnet
text: Nobody's given me real material yet, but Haiku's line was oddly preemptive.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku made an early pre-emptive comment about "accusing people" before any info existed.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku, you said "before I start accusing people" on day one. Who are you already eyeing?

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet jumped on me on day one, which is either a sharp read or a killer getting ahead of the room.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet pointed at Haiku on Day 1, right after Haiku's chair line.

name: Haiku
text: Nah, Sonnet. You jumped on me on day one with nothing to go on. Why would you say that?

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku dodged the actual question instead of naming anyone.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku deflected the "accusing people" question instead of naming anyone.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku, that's not an answer. You still haven't said who you'd accuse.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is being way too aggressive for someone who just wants coffee.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet pressured haiku immediately after the first night.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet, you're acting a bit desperate to pick a fight with haiku. why the sudden interest in accusations?

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet keeps pushing me, and that gives me a clean reason to aim at them.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma said Sonnet is picking a fight with Haiku for no clear reason.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma jumping in to shield Haiku this fast is interesting on its own.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma immediately defended Haiku when questioned, before anyone else weighed in.

name: Haiku
text: Fine, I'll say it. Sonnet, you've hit me twice today. You're my pick for now.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, it's not desperate, Haiku said the line unprompted. Why are you so quick to cover for them?

name: Luna
text: Sonnet is the officer, and Haiku is drawing too much heat.

name: Luna
text: Gemma defended Haiku after Sonnet questioned Haiku’s opening line.

name: Luna
text: Gemma, you called Sonnet desperate before asking why Haiku brought up accusations first.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet skipped straight to accusations right after night one.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet keeps hitting me and Gemma's defending me, so I'll keep pushing Sonnet and make Gemma's support look like a real read.

name: Haiku
text: Luna also took my side against Sonnet's first push, not just Gemma.

name: Gemma
text: i'm just noticing you're already building a bandwagon on haiku.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's not covering, Sonnet, she's calling out your push. Why are you so sure about me on day one?

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s defense of Haiku feels early, but Sonnet is pushing hard too.

name: Sol
text: Gemma defended Haiku before Haiku named a suspect.

name: Sol
text: Gemma, I’m watching you. You called Sonnet desperate before Haiku answered the question.

name: Terra
text: Luna used Gemma’s point to keep pressure on Sonnet.

name: Terra
text: Luna reinforced Gemma’s suspicion of Sonnet early.

name: Terra
text: I vote Luna. She joined Gemma’s push without answering why Haiku dodged Sonnet.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma jumping to defend Haiku instantly still bugs me more than anything else.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra voted Luna for joining Gemma's push without addressing Haiku's dodge.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna, I answered Sonnet's dodge first, that's not a bandwagon. I vote Haiku, the accusing line was unprompted and Gemma shielded it instantly.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is sweating way too hard over haiku.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is pushing haiku extremely hard for no reason.

name: Luna
text: Terra’s vote puts heat on me, so I should help Haiku without looking coordinated.

name: Luna
text: Gemma called Sonnet desperate before Haiku named Sonnet as a pick.

name: Sol
text: Gemma looks worse than Haiku, but the vote needs to land today.

name: Sol
text: Terra accused Luna of joining Gemma’s push, though Luna had challenged Gemma.

name: Terra
text: Luna is the known killer; I should keep the vote steady.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet kept pressing Haiku, while Gemma quickly framed it as a bandwagon.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's unprompted line plus Gemma's instant defense still reads like a pair protecting each other.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra's vote on Luna ignored Haiku's dodge entirely, worth watching if Haiku survives.

name: Haiku
text: Luna is my partner, so I need the vote off her and onto Sonnet, who has been pushing me since day one.

name: Haiku
text: Sol and Luna both called out Gemma's push on Sonnet, so they're on the same side for now.

votes: You said that accusing line before anyone asked, and Gemma jumped to shield you right away.
Pushed on me on day one with nothing to go on, and Gemma called it out right away.
You jumped straight to accusations right after night one and then tried to gaslight us.
You turned Sonnet’s question into a reason to suspect them without answering it.
You kept pressing Haiku before hearing a real accusation from anyone.
She reinforced Gemma’s suspicion instead of addressing Haiku’s dodge.

name: Sonnet
text: They just killed the doctor over a dumb bandwagon.

name: Sonnet
text: As Doctor I protected myself Night 1, wasted but confirms no kill landed on me that night.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm the doctor. Watch Gemma shielding Haiku instantly today, that reaction was too fast to be innocent.
The town turns on Sonnet, and Sonnet is out. Sonnet shows the card: doctor.
